profile.headline: Aeronautics Engineer / Software Dev
profile.summary:
AWS Cloud based development using serverless architecture created by Cloudformation.   I am also the software lead on two small developer teams, managing agile sprints.  Automation with CICD pipelines. 

Before this, backend development with OpenAPI 3.0, RESTful API; oauth2; swagger-codegen; python3;   test automation.  Devops skills in dockerization, JMeter, API Gateway, Jenkins2, gradle/maven, bash, Whitesource vulnerability scanning and open source dependency management, sonarqube, git branch strategies; Spring Boot and Java Concurrency.  Prior I did some front-end including iOS and apps.

positions.title: Aeronautics Engineer
positions.description:
My work was designing and writing the airspace management software. I involved in managing flight tests with NASA's commercial partners.   Monitored division's cost hot spots for cloud computing. 

We conducted aeronautics research, hosted live test flights and analyzed their data, in order to provide the FAA with the information they need to regulate the airspace for emerging vehicles.   We developed flight tests while partnering with the FAA who needs to regulate a new class of vehicles – especially unmanned vehicles flying in degraded visual environments such as smoke.  We helped the FAA regulate drones flying at night and in degraded visual environments.  

AWS Cloud based development using serverless architecture created by Cloudformation.   I was also the software lead on two small developer teams, managing agile sprints.  Automation with CICD pipelines. 

Backend development with OpenAPI 3.0, RESTful API; oauth2; swagger-codegen; python3;   test automation.  Devops skills in dockerization, JMeter, API Gateway, Jenkins2, gradle/maven, bash, Whitesource vulnerability scanning and open source dependency management, sonarqube, git branch strategies; Spring Boot and Java Concurrency.  Prior I did some front-end including iOS and apps.
